biggest_catch: Gengo publishes no per-word pay rate anywhere on its public pages — you only learn what a job pays after you have passed their two-part test, been approved, and are looking at the job board.
catches: No official published pay rate: earnings are only revealed per-job on the job details page after signup and approval.

Zero guaranteed tasks — work is claimed from a board; volume varies by language pair and customer demand (Gengo's own page: 'Income varies across languages depending on customer demand and job availability').
Qualification barrier: free account plus a two-part translator test; a separate Pro qualification test unlocks higher-reward projects.
Effective hourly pay can be low: per-word crowd pricing with tight turnaround expectations.
Could not confirm official payout method, minimum threshold, or payment timing on any official page.
One language earnings widget on the official page showed the number '300' with no units or context — not a usable pay figure.

c1.evidence: Gengo is a real operating company (now part of Lionbridge); official translators page at gengo.com/translators loaded live.

c2.evidence: Official translator FAQ describes how the platform works (sign up, test, claim jobs, payments auto-added to account), but states no pay figure.

c3.evidence: Signup and translator test are free per the official page ('Create a free account and take our two-part test').

c4.evidence: No official published pay rate found — FAQ says 'The total reward for each translation is displayed on the job details page,' which is a mechanism description, not a concrete figure.

eligibility: Bilingual in an accepted language pair; pass Gengo's two-part translator test; (optional) pass the Pro qualification test for higher-reward projects.
notes: Read gengo.com/translators live (2026-09-22): FAQ 'How much does a Gengo translator earn?' says 'Income varies across languages depending on customer demand and job availability' with a per-language monthly earnings widget (showed '300', no units); 'How do I get paid?' says 'The total reward for each translation is displayed on the job details page and will be automatically added to your reward balance when the job is approved by the customer.' Searched gengo.com and support.gengo.com for a published per-word rate — none found. Could not confirm payout method, minimum balance, or payment timing from official pages. Third-party reviews cite historical rates (~$0.03/word standard) but are not official.

s1.note: Must pass the two-part translator test and work only in approved language pairs; Pro qualification test gates higher-reward projects.

s2.note: Per-job reward shown only after signup/approval; work is claimed from a board, not assigned; customer approval gates payment.

s3.note: Payment timing/minimums could not be confirmed from official pages.

s4.note: Official page makes no concrete earnings promise — 'Income varies' is stated plainly, which is honest but not verifiable as a payout.

s6.note: No concrete steps to a guaranteed payout exist — rejected per verdict rules, so steps omitted.

s7.note: Official Gengo translator page read live 2026-09-22.
